User model choice
Admin accounts are company-linked via OrganisationMembership.
Trainees may be company-linked or general, and general trainees can receive PREMADE_GENERAL CampaignAssignments without OrganisationMembership.
Please note: campaignType:ORGANISATION_ASSIGNED | PREMADE_GENERAL
